title.zh: 主动出行（电子送达系统）条例 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 2 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Active Mobility (Electronic Service System) Regulations 2019 and come into operation on 3 June 2019.

2. In these Regulations, “electronic service system” means the system providing for electronic service established under section 43 of the Land Transport Authority of Singapore Act 1995.
[S 141/2022 wef 31/12/2021]

heading.en: Authorisation to serve documents through electronic service system

text.en:
3.—(1) For the purposes of section 64(5)(d) of the Act, a document in relation to a matter specified in the First Schedule is authorised to be served through the electronic service system on the Authority.
[S 141/2022 wef 31/12/2021]
(2) For the purposes of section 64(5)(d) of the Act, a document in relation to a matter specified in the Second Schedule is authorised to be served through the electronic service system on an individual, a partnership, a body corporate or an unincorporated association.
[S 141/2022 wef 31/12/2021]
